DISCHARGE PLAN & FOLLOW-UP:
1. Medication Reconciliation: Discharged on Bumex 1mg PO daily (replacing home Lasix), Carvedilol 12.5mg PO BID, Lisinopril 10mg PO daily, and Metformin 500mg PO BID.
2. Home Health: Home health nursing ordered for twice-weekly blood pressure, weight checks, and basic metabolic panel draws.
3. Follow-up: Scheduled to see primary care physician in 5 days and cardiology in 2 weeks.
